extDescription.message: Show YouTube captions plus an on-device translation (Japanese by default; pick another language from the toolbar icon) in an always-on-top floating window that stays visible on other tabs and apps.

unsupported.message: This feature requires Chrome 116 or later (Document Picture-in-Picture).

noCaptions.message: No captions are available for this video.

statusNoApi.message: The Translator API is not available here (Chrome 138 or later is required)

statusNoLang.message: Could not detect the caption language

captionsUnreadable.message: No captions could be read. The video may have none, or YouTube's page may have changed.

popupHint.message: Applies right away to open YouTube tabs. The first use of a language may download a model (Chrome built-in Translator).

statusNeedsGesture.message: Downloading this translation model needs a click. Close the window and open it again
